verdict.rationale: The evidence includes only a pricing-page mention of a 'Gemini AI assistant in Gmail' and an admin update about Meet's 'Take notes for me' feature. Both suggest first-party, in-product AI that works on user data, but neither documents what insights or suggestions it produces. missing for 10: documentation of AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data (e.g., in Docs, Sheets, Drive), detail on how the Gmail assistant analyzes data, coverage across the suite, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: New Google Meet 'Take notes for me' settings for admins and end users take effect September 29th
